problem: Online delivery of movies was becoming possible.
title: Netflix adds streaming to every subscription at no extra cost
context: Netflix was a DVD-by-mail service with about 6 million subscribers.
decision_made: Launch Watch Now streaming inside existing subscription plans, with hours of streaming tied to the plan.
action_taken: Launched on 16 January 2007 with about 1,000 titles in a browser applet that required Windows XP, and rolled it out to all subscribers by June.
observed_outcome: Not documented in the sources used.
lessons: A small, included feature can be the start of a larger shift when the underlying technology matures.
limitations: Only the launch was checked here, not later adoption. The company later made streaming central to its business.

claims.claim_text: Netflix offered Watch Now streaming to subscribers at no additional cost, starting 16 January 2007.
The initial library was about 1,000 titles and used a Windows-only browser applet.
